entries.speaker: Dana Scully

entries.text: [ gunshots ]
entries.speaker: Sound

entries.text: Oh, my god.
entries.speaker: Mrs. Holt

entries.text: What is it? What happened? Agent Scully! Scully.
entries.speaker: John Doggett

entries.text: [ crying ]
entries.speaker: Sound

entries.text: You going to be okay, agent Scully? I got a drift of what happened in there... To you. I mean, sort of.
entries.speaker: John Doggett

entries.text: I shot a young boy.
entries.speaker: Dana Scully

entries.text: The good news is, you're wrong.
entries.speaker: John Doggett

entries.text: But it's what I saw. With my eyes, anyway. Do you know what it's like not to be able to trust your own eyes?
entries.speaker: Dana Scully

entries.text: Then why'd you shoot him?
entries.speaker: John Doggett

entries.text: [ breathes slowly ]
entries.speaker: Sound

entries.text: Because it's what the boy saw. And in an instant... I realized that it's what Mulder would have seen or understood. Because that's just how he came at things... Without judgment and without prejudice and with an open mind that I am just not capable of.
entries.speaker: Dana Scully

entries.text: It's been a long night. Give yourself a break.
entries.speaker: John Doggett

entries.text: [ sighs ]
entries.speaker: Sound

entries.text: This whole thing doesn't make any sense.
entries.speaker: John Doggett

entries.text: No... It did. In some way, it did.
entries.speaker: Dana Scully

entries.text: [ beggars shouting ]
entries.speaker: Sound
